grid.title: Produção PA
grid.expression: SELECT ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, SUM(ITE.QTDNEG) AS QTDNEG FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD WHERE PRO.USOPROD = 'V' AND TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI) >= :P_DTENTSAI.INI AND TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI) <= :P_DTENTSAI.FIN AND CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (800,213) GROUP BY ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD

grid.title: Produção PI
grid.expression: SELECT ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, SUM(ITE.QTDNEG) AS QTDNEG FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD WHERE TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI) >= :P_DTENTSAI.INI AND TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI) <= :P_DTENTSAI.FIN AND CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (801) AND SUBSTR(ITE.CODPROD,0,1) = 2 GROUP BY ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD ORDER BY ITE.CODPROD

grid.title: Produção PI Manuel
grid.expression: SELECT ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, SUM(ITE.QTDNEG) AS QTDNEG, SUM(ITE.VLRUNIT*QTDNEG) / SUM(ITE.QTDNEG) AS VLRUNIT, SUM(ITE.AD_VLRCHEIOCOM*QTDNEG) / SUM(ITE.QTDNEG) AS VLRCHEIO FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD WHERE TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI) >= :P_DTENTSAI.INI AND TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI) <= :P_DTENTSAI.FIN AND CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (1211) --AND SUBSTR(ITE.CODPROD,0,1) = 2 GROUP BY ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD ORDER BY ITE.CODPROD
